user.title: Connect Dreame Home Laundry
user.description: Connect your Dreame Home account to access your L9 washing machine and Twin Inverter L9 dryer. Choose the server region used by the Dreame Home app. Your password is used for login; Home Assistant stores the refresh token.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the credentials for the same Dreame Home account and region.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Dreame cloud or obtain a complete device list.
error.rate_limited: Dreame is limiting requests. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Dreame account and region are already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Sign in with the same account and region as the existing integration.
